lines.2: 「Wait. Doesn't that mean you'd abandon me?」
lines.3: 「Then you'd hate it if somebody took one of your bottle ships hostage, right?」
lines.4: 「Whoa! Stepped right on a land mine!」
lines.5: 「Aww, now you've made him snap. You should know better than to mention bottle ships, little Crab.」
lines.6: 「Your reaction is completely different from when it was me...」
lines.7: 「Forget the hostage plan. The retaliation sounds scary, and taking hostages is kind of lame anyway.」
lines.8: 「Come to think of it, cousins can marry each other, can't they?」
lines.10: 「You'd look good with an older wife.」
lines.13: 「To me, Otome is an object of awe.」
lines.14: 「She's beautiful, and I think she's cool.」
lines.15: 「But I don't have romantic feelings for her.」
lines.16: 「If I married someone that disciplined, the stress would make me go bald.」
lines.17: 「Yeah, exactly! I know what you mean. Big sisters are just terrifying. They experiment on your body without a second thought. Mine used to put firecrackers down the back of my shirt.」
lines.19: 「Ah... ah... ah... Oh, no. The memories are coming back.」
lines.23: 「Once he gets like this, all we can do is leave him alone.」
